resources.string: Reconnects to the same game after a dropped connection, up to five times a minute.
Reconnecting to your game… Attempt %1$d of %2$d. Press Back to cancel.
The previous game session is no longer available. Automatic recovery stopped to avoid starting or replacing a game.
Another device is playing this game in a browser, and this stream can’t run beside it. End that stream first.
Automatic recovery could not reconnect within one minute. Your game was not quit. Check the connection, then choose Reconnect to try again.
Automatic recovery stopped when you left the stream. Choose Reconnect to continue.
The previous connection has not closed yet. Try again in a moment.
The PC didn’t answer the start within %1$d seconds. Try again, or check what the PC is doing.
